Illinois Department of Revenue — Bulletin FY 2026-15, What's New for Illinois Income Taxes
Illinois Department of Revenue — What is the Illinois personal exemption allowance?

personalExemptionCredit.note: Illinois allows a personal exemption as a deduction from base income: $2,925 per allowance for tax year 2026 (up from $2,850 in 2025). Booklet IL-700-T works the joint figure as 2 x $2,925 = $5,850. The exemption is unavailable above $250,000 of adjusted gross income ($500,000 filing jointly).

notes: Illinois has a flat 4.95% income tax written into its constitution — a 2020 ballot measure to allow graduated rates failed.
Illinois does not tax retirement income, including distributions from 401(k) plans, IRAs, and Social Security.
Illinois does not conform to the federal Qualified Business Income deduction.
